items.author: Julia Poe
items.body_excerpt: A couple Bulls players posed this question themselves this week — Jalen Smith didn’t like his listed height — but haven’t gotten a firm answer on how medical reports these. Both amusing and a little frustrating to have 3+ reported heights circling for different players.

quote.author: Doug Seibold
quote.text: Why have Bulls recently listed players' heights as less than their actual heights? This piece refers to Essengue--he measured 6-10 at the combine (100% credible), but Bulls had him at 6-8. They've done same with Collins, Smith, and many if not most of the others. Small thing but noticeable!
